text.tspan: Phase 2: Interactive Seat Selection & Booking Submission
Phase 3: Server Validation & Atomic Concurrency Guard
CRITICAL ATOMIC STEP: Single-Document Atomic Update
[Race Condition: Another Patron Booked A1 or A2 milliseconds earlier]

svg.text: Query showtime document with embedded seats[]
200 OK: { showtime: { seats: [...], movie, theater, price } }
Renders curved auditorium screen & seat grid
Verifies selection <= 8 seats & checks auth token
Forwards request with req.user = { id, email, role }
Validate payload: showtimeId exists & Array.isArray(seats) && seats.length > 0
Verify all requested seats exist in showtime layout
Pre-check: verify none of requested seats have isBooked === true

findOneAndUpdate({ _id: showtimeId, seats: { $not: { $elemMatch: { seatNumber: { $in: seats }, isBooked: true } } } }, { $set: { seats.$[elem].isBooked: true, seats.$[elem].bookedBy: userId } }, { arrayFilters: [...] })
409 Conflict: { error: 'One or more selected seats were reserved just now...' }
Fresh seat map with A1/A2 marked red
new Booking({ bookingReference, user, movie, showtime, seats, totalAmount, status: 'confirmed' }).save()
updateOne({ _id: booking.showtime }, { $set: { seats.$[elem].isBooked: false, seats.$[elem].bookedBy: null } }, { arrayFilters: [...] })
200 OK: { message: 'Booking cancelled and seats released' }
Displays success alert & updates pass to 'Cancelled'
